CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.
   B. Say Physical has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Sharing values? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Sharing values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Sharing values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sharing values.
   D. Say Sharing values has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Wedding? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wedding.
   B. Use Wedding to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Wedding has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.
   B. Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story: Holy Bible.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story;.
   C. Say The Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ.
   C. Say Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.
   C. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

11. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My 1.0 Creation.
   B. Say My 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   C. Use My 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain My 1.0 Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Creation of Plants and Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Physical and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
